summary: Cylindrical planetary gearbox with a small DC motor mounted coaxially at one end. The stacked housing stages sit between the motor and a round output end case. A single round output shaft extends from the output end on the motor axis. Two tie rods run along the housing, and the bracket feet are flat, L-shaped and perforated, attached at the output end and the motor end.

mountingSurfaces.description: Underside of the flat bracket feet at the output end and the motor end, used to mount the unit on a flat surface. The feet have a row of small perforations.

notes: No overall dimensions are printed in the drawings, and the supplied length, width, height and diameter fields are null and flagged unverified. The bounds are rough visual estimates, with x along the motor and output axis, and should be checked against a datasheet or measurement. The only stated dimension is the 4 mm round output shaft, and the drawing mentions 3 mm tie bolts and nuts. The bracket perforations are visible but their diameters and positions are not given, so no holes are listed. The 3-6 V rating and the gear ratio options are not geometric inputs.
